The '''Schenor/Imperial treaty''' was an agreement between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Schenor]] [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Schenor government|government]]. The treaty authorized the Empire to construct a [[Unidentified Imperial base (Rhamsis Callo)|base]] on [[Rhamsis Callo]], the Schenor [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Following an [[Massacre at the Schenor research station|attack]] on a [[Schenor research station|research station]] operated by the Schenor, [[B'karitz]], an important Schenor noble and [[nest-guildmaster]], nullified the treaty and banned the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] from their world.<ref name="TRG1-116" />
